data.name: ExitListRead
data.value: Your extract list is read: {count, plural, one {# extract} other {# extracts}} for this raid
data.comment: Notice, once per raid, after the extract list was read from a screenshot. {count}: how many extracts it names.

data.name: NoGameTitle
data.value: No game found on this PC
data.comment: Rail, where the Plan card would be while no game is found on this PC; shown in capitals.

data.name: NoGameNote
data.value: Or browse the maps above. Quests and raids follow the game once it's found; Shturmap keeps looking.
data.comment: Rail, under 'No game found on this PC': what still works.

data.name: NoLogsTitle
data.value: The game hasn't run on this PC yet
data.comment: Rail, where the Plan card would be while the game is found but has no logs yet; shown in capitals.

data.name: NoLogsNote
data.value: Found in {folder}. Quests and raids follow once it has run here; until then, browse the maps above.
data.comment: Rail, under 'The game hasn't run on this PC yet'. {folder}: the game's folder, a path.

data.name: StatusLoadingMap
data.comment: Status bar, while a raid loads. {map}: the raid's map, Customs.

data.name: StatusLoading
data.comment: Status bar, while a raid loads on a map Shturmap can't name.

data.name: StatusInRaid
data.comment: Status bar in a raid, the first of its parts: 'In raid · Customs · PMC · 12 min'.

data.name: SidePmc
data.comment: Status bar and Plan's last-raid line: the side the raid is played as. The game's word.

data.name: SideScav
data.comment: Status bar and Plan's last-raid line: the side the raid is played as. The game's word.

data.name: RaidMinutes
data.comment: Status bar and Plan's last-raid line: a raid's length so far or in all. {minutes}: whole minutes, 12.

data.name: StatusNotInRaid
data.comment: Status bar, outside a raid.

data.name: LastRaid
data.comment: Plan, the last raid's line, its first part: 'Last raid · Customs · 12 min · PMC'.

data.name: LastRaidEndUnknown
data.comment: Plan, the last raid's line, in place of its length: the game's log never said when the raid ended.

data.name: StatusTipLoading
data.value: The game's log shows a raid loading
data.comment: Status bar's tooltip while a raid loads: where the words come from.

data.name: StatusTipInRaidSince
data.value: The game's log shows a raid, started {time}
data.comment: Status bar's tooltip in a raid. {time}: when it started, 16:40, or 4 Oct 16:40 on another day.

data.name: StatusTipInRaid
data.value: The game's log shows a raid
data.comment: Status bar's tooltip in a raid whose start isn't known.

data.name: StatusTipMenu
data.value: The game's log shows no raid (it can't tell the menus from a closed game)
data.comment: Status bar's tooltip outside a raid.

data.name: ModePvp
data.comment: Status bar: the game mode, as the game calls it.

data.name: ModePve
data.comment: Status bar: the game mode, as the game calls it.

data.name: ModeSeasonal
data.comment: Status bar: the game mode, as the game calls it (the seasonal PvP mode).

data.name: ModeTipUnknown
data.value: The game says '{mode}', which Shturmap doesn't know yet; showing the mode you last played
data.comment: Status bar, the mode's tooltip. {mode}: the mode as the game's log names it, as it is (not translated).

data.name: ModeTipFromLog
data.comment: Status bar, the mode's tooltip. {time}: when the log named the mode, 16:40, or 4 Oct 16:40 on another day.

data.name: ModeTipLastPlayed
data.value: The mode you last played; follows the game once it starts
data.comment: Status bar, the mode's tooltip before the game's log has named one.

data.name: ModeTipNoGame
data.value: No game on this PC: the mode you last played
data.comment: Status bar, the mode's tooltip while no game is found.

data.name: GameFolderNotFound
data.comment: Settings, the game folder line, in capitals as the headings are.

data.name: GameFolderChosen
data.comment: Settings, the game folder line, in capitals as the headings are (the folder as it is). {folder}: the game's folder, a path.

data.name: GameFolderFound
data.comment: Settings, the game folder line, in capitals as the headings are (the folder as it is). {folder}: the game's folder, a path.

data.name: LogsTipNotFound
data.value: The game's logs aren't found: quests and raids can't follow the game.
data.comment: Status bar, the LOGS light's tooltip, and settings.

data.name: LogsTipFolder
data.comment: Status bar, the LOGS light's tooltip, and settings: the logs followed. {folder}: a path.

data.name: LogsTipNewer
data.value: Newer game logs in {folder}. Settings → FIND AUTOMATICALLY follows those instead.
data.comment: Status bar, the LOGS light's tooltip, and settings, the line under 'Game logs: …' when another install has newer logs than the chosen folder. {folder}: that install's folder, a path. FIND AUTOMATICALLY: the settings button's label, as it reads there.

data.name: UpdatesBroken
data.value: Updates: the updater couldn't start, so no update checks. The log says why (LOG FOLDER). Running the Setup again repairs it; your data stays.
data.comment: Settings, under Updates, in an installed Shturmap whose updater failed. LOG FOLDER: the settings button's label, as it reads there; the Setup: Shturmap's installer.

data.name: UpdatesNotInBuild
data.value: Updates: not available in this build. Installed with the Setup, Shturmap updates itself.
data.comment: Settings, under Updates, in a build that wasn't installed. The Setup: Shturmap's installer.

data.name: UpdateNotApplied
data.value: Update {version} couldn't be applied: another program kept Shturmap's folder in use, often a browser Shturmap opened. Close it, then restart Shturmap.
data.comment: Notice at start, when a downloaded update failed to apply. {version}: the version, 0.4.1.

data.name: UpdateAvailable
data.comment: Rail, the update line above Plan between raids ('Tell me only'), shown in capitals. {version}: the version, 0.4.1.

data.name: UpdateDownloading
data.comment: Rail, the update line above Plan between raids, shown in capitals. {version}: the version, 0.4.1.

data.name: UpdateDidNotApply
data.value: Update {version} didn't apply: close what Shturmap opened, then restart
data.comment: Rail, the update line above Plan between raids, shown in capitals, over RESTART NOW. {version}: the version, 0.4.1.

data.name: UpdateReady
data.value: Update {version} ready: applies at next start
data.comment: Rail, the update line above Plan between raids, shown in capitals, over RESTART NOW. {version}: the version, 0.4.1.

data.name: SettingsFileSetAside
data.value: Shturmap's settings file couldn't be read and was set aside: picks, ticks and settings start over.
data.comment: Notice at start. Picks: the quests picked for a raid; ticks: objectives ticked as done.

data.name: SettingsFileNotKept
data.value: Shturmap's settings file couldn't be opened: picks, ticks and settings aren't kept this time.
data.comment: Notice at start. Picks: the quests picked for a raid; ticks: objectives ticked as done.

data.comment: Status bar, the SCREENSHOTS chip: the game's screenshots folder is there.

data.name: ChipData

data.name: ChipDataOffline
data.comment: Status bar, the DATA chip: the saved copy of tarkov.dev's data is shown.

data.name: ChipNoData
data.comment: Status bar, the DATA chip: tarkov.dev's data couldn't be loaded.

data.name: ChipNoLogs
data.comment: Status bar, the LOGS chip: the game's logs aren't found.

data.name: ChipLogsLive
data.comment: Status bar, the LOGS chip: the game wrote to its log in the last ten minutes.

data.name: ChipLogs
